question_en: Which of the expressions give the work of a direct current? 1) $A=IUt$; 2) $A=I^2Rt$; 3) $A=Fs\cos\alpha$; 4) $A=q(\varphi_1-\varphi_2)$; 5) $A=IU$.
question_uz: Quyidagi ifodalardan qaysilari o'zgarmas tokning ishini ifodalaydi? 1) $A=IUt$; 2) $A=I^2Rt$; 3) $A=Fs\cos\alpha$; 4) $A=q(\varphi_1-\varphi_2)$; 5) $A=IU$.
question_ru: Какие из выражений выражают работу постоянного тока? 1) $A=IUt$; 2) $A=I^2Rt$; 3) $A=Fs\cos\alpha$; 4) $A=q(\varphi_1-\varphi_2)$; 5) $A=IU$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Tok ishi A = IUt = I²Rt = qU, bu yerda U = φ₁ − φ₂. A = Fs·cosα — mexanik ish, IU esa quvvat.
Asos: A = qU = IUt.

en: 1, 2 and 4 are the work of current: $$A=qU=IUt=I^2Rt$$

distractors.A: mexanik ish va quvvat formulasi tanlangan
distractors.C: mexanik ish tanlangan, IUt tushib qolgan

distractors_ru.A: выбраны формулы механической работы и мощности

distractors_en.A: the formulas of mechanical work and power were chosen
distractors_en.C: mechanical work was chosen, IUt was left out
distractors_en.D: the power (IU) was taken as work

question_en: What is the basic SI unit of the physical quantity whose unit can be written as $\mathrm{J/(A^2\cdot s)}$?
question_uz: Birligi $\mathrm{J/(A^2\cdot s)}$ ko'rinishda yoziladigan fizik kattalikning SI dagi asosiy birligi qaysi?
question_ru: Какова основная единица в СИ физической величины, единицу которой можно записать как $\mathrm{J/(A^2\cdot s)}$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Q = I²Rt dan R = Q/(I²t), demak J/(A²·s) — qarshilik birligi, ya'ni om.
Asos: Joul–Lens qonuni Q = I²Rt.

distractors_en.A: the unit of voltage is J/C
distractors_en.B: the unit of power is J/s
distractors_en.D: the unit of charge is A·s
distractors_en.E: the unit of capacitance is C/V

question_en: How much energy ($\mathrm{kJ}$) does an electric kettle of power $0.8\ \mathrm{kW}$ consume in $6$ minutes?
question_uz: Quvvati $0.8\ \mathrm{kW}$ bo'lgan elektr choynak $6$ minutda qancha energiya ($\mathrm{kJ}$) iste'mol qiladi?
question_ru: Сколько энергии ($\mathrm{kJ}$) потребляет электрочайник мощностью $0.8\ \mathrm{kW}$ за $6$ минут?

distractors_en.B: the minutes were not converted to seconds
distractors_en.D: the time was multiplied by 60 once more
distractors_en.E: the power was divided by the time: 800/360

question_en: A lamp base is marked $220\ \mathrm{V}$, $40\ \mathrm{W}$. What is the resistance of the lamp ($\Omega$) in the working state?
question_uz: Lampa sokoliga $220\ \mathrm{V}$, $40\ \mathrm{W}$ deb yozilgan. Ish rejimida lampaning qarshiligi qanday ($\Omega$)?
question_ru: На цоколе лампы написано $220\ \mathrm{V}$, $40\ \mathrm{W}$. Каково сопротивление лампы ($\Omega$) в рабочем режиме?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. P = U²/R dan R = U²/P = 220²/40 = 48 400/40 = 1210 Ω.
Asos: R = U₀²/P₀.

distractors_ru.B: мощность разделена на напряжение — это ток

distractors_en.A: the voltage was divided by the power: U/P
distractors_en.B: the power was divided by the voltage — this is the current
distractors_en.E: U² was not divided by the power

question_en: The current in a conductor of constant resistance decreased $3$ times. Find the ratio of the powers $\frac{P_2}{P_1}$.
question_uz: O'zgarmas qarshilikli o'tkazgichdagi tok kuchi $3$ marta kamaydi. Quvvatlar nisbati $\frac{P_2}{P_1}$ ni toping.
question_ru: Сила тока в проводнике с постоянным сопротивлением уменьшилась в $3$ раза. Найдите отношение мощностей $\frac{P_2}{P_1}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. R o'zgarmas: P = I²R ∼ I². Tok 3 marta kamaysa, quvvat 9 marta kamayadi: P₂/P₁ = 1/9.
Asos: P = I²R.

distractors_ru.A: считали, что мощность растёт, без квадрата

distractors_en.A: the power was assumed to grow, without the square
distractors_en.C: the power was assumed to grow
distractors_en.D: the power was assumed not to change

question_en: At an unchanged current the resistance of a conductor decreased $4$ times. Find the ratio of the powers $\frac{P_2}{P_1}$.
question_uz: Tok kuchi o'zgarmagan holda o'tkazgichning qarshiligi $4$ marta kamaydi. Quvvatlar nisbati $\frac{P_2}{P_1}$ ni toping.
question_ru: При неизменной силе тока сопротивление проводника уменьшилось в $4$ раза. Найдите отношение мощностей $\frac{P_2}{P_1}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Tok o'zgarmas, demak P = I²R ∼ R. Qarshilik 4 marta kamaysa, quvvat ham 4 marta kamayadi.
Asos: P = I²R.

distractors.A: U o'zgarmas deb, P = U²/R ishlatilgan

distractors_ru.A: считали U постоянным, взяли P = U²/R
distractors_ru.C: взято P ∼ 1/R и возведено в квадрат

distractors_en.A: U was taken constant, P = U²/R was used
distractors_en.E: the power was assumed not to change

question_en: Two heaters of resistances $R_1=25\ \Omega$ and $R_2=100\ \Omega$ are connected to the mains in series. Find the ratio of their powers $\frac{P_1}{P_2}$.
question_uz: Qarshiliklari $R_1=25\ \Omega$ va $R_2=100\ \Omega$ bo'lgan ikki isitkich tarmoqqa ketma-ket ulangan. Ulardagi quvvatlar nisbati $\frac{P_1}{P_2}$ ni toping.
question_ru: Два нагревателя сопротивлениями $R_1=25\ \Omega$ и $R_2=100\ \Omega$ включены в сеть последовательно. Найдите отношение мощностей $\frac{P_1}{P_2}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Ketma-ket ulashda tok bir xil, P = I²R ∼ R: P₁/P₂ = R₁/R₂ = 25/100 = 1/4.
Asos: ketma-ket P₁/P₂ = R₁/R₂.

distractors.E: tok bir xil bo'lsa, quvvat ham teng deb olingan

distractors_ru.E: считали, что при равном токе мощности равны

distractors_en.A: the formula for parallel connection was used
distractors_en.B: the parallel formula and the squared ratio
distractors_en.E: equal currents were assumed to give equal powers

question_en: A current of $2.5\ \mathrm{A}$ flows in a wire of resistance $8\ \Omega$. How much heat ($\mathrm{kJ}$) is released in the wire in $2$ minutes?
question_uz: Qarshiligi $8\ \Omega$ bo'lgan simdan $2.5\ \mathrm{A}$ tok o'tmoqda. $2$ minutda simda qancha issiqlik ($\mathrm{kJ}$) ajraladi?
question_ru: По проводу сопротивлением $8\ \Omega$ идёт ток $2.5\ \mathrm{A}$. Сколько теплоты ($\mathrm{kJ}$) выделится в проводе за $2$ минуты?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Q = I²Rt = 2,5²·8·120 = 6,25·960 = 6000 J = 6 kJ.
Asos: Joul–Lens qonuni Q = I²Rt.

distractors_en.C: the minutes were not converted to seconds
distractors_en.D: the time was multiplied by 60 once more
distractors_en.E: divided by R instead of multiplying

question_en: A charge of $15\ \mathrm{C}$ passed through a stationary conductor with a voltage of $6\ \mathrm{V}$ across it. How much heat ($\mathrm{J}$) was released in the conductor?
question_uz: Uchlaridagi kuchlanish $6\ \mathrm{V}$ bo'lgan qo'zg'almas o'tkazgichdan $15\ \mathrm{C}$ zaryad o'tdi. O'tkazgichda qancha issiqlik ($\mathrm{J}$) ajraldi?
question_ru: Через неподвижный проводник с напряжением $6\ \mathrm{V}$ на концах прошёл заряд $15\ \mathrm{C}$. Сколько теплоты ($\mathrm{J}$) выделилось в проводнике?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Qo'zg'almas o'tkazgichda tok ishining hammasi issiqlikka aylanadi: Q = A = qU = 15·6 = 90 J.
Asos: Q = qU.

en: All the work turns into heat: $$Q=A=qU=15\cdot6=90\ \mathrm{J}$$

distractors_en.A: the charge was divided by the voltage
distractors_en.B: the voltage was divided by the charge

question_en: A $60\ \mathrm{W}$ lamp rated for $220\ \mathrm{V}$ is connected to a mains of voltage $110\ \mathrm{V}$. With what power ($\mathrm{W}$) does the lamp burn? Take the resistance as constant.
question_uz: $220\ \mathrm{V}$ kuchlanishga mo'ljallangan $60\ \mathrm{W}$ li lampa $110\ \mathrm{V}$ kuchlanishli tarmoqqa ulandi. Lampa qanday quvvat ($\mathrm{W}$) bilan yonadi? Qarshilikni o'zgarmas deb oling.
question_ru: Лампу $60\ \mathrm{W}$, рассчитанную на напряжение $220\ \mathrm{V}$, включили в сеть напряжением $110\ \mathrm{V}$. С какой мощностью ($\mathrm{W}$) горит лампа? Сопротивление считайте постоянным.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. R o'zgarmas, P ∼ U². Kuchlanish 2 marta kamaydi — quvvat 4 marta kamayadi: 60/4 = 15 W.
Asos: P = P₀(U/U₀)².

en: The power is proportional to voltage squared: $$P=P_0\left(\frac{U}{U_0}\right)^2=60\cdot\frac{1}{4}=15\ \mathrm{W}$$

distractors_en.A: the power was taken proportional to the voltage
distractors_en.B: the rated power was assumed to remain
distractors_en.C: the power was assumed to grow

question_en: Two lamps of powers $P$ and $3P$ rated for the same voltage are connected in series to a mains of that voltage. What is the total power of both lamps?
question_uz: Bir xil kuchlanishga mo'ljallangan, quvvatlari $P$ va $3P$ bo'lgan ikki lampa shu kuchlanishli tarmoqqa ketma-ket ulandi. Ikkala lampaning umumiy quvvati qanday?
question_ru: Две лампы мощностями $P$ и $3P$, рассчитанные на одно напряжение, включили последовательно в сеть с этим напряжением. Какова общая мощность обеих ламп?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. R ∼ 1/P, ketma-ket ulashda P = P₁P₂/(P₁+P₂) = P·3P/(4P) = 3P/4 — eng kichik quvvatdan ham kichik.
Asos: P = P₁P₂/(P₁+P₂).

distractors_ru.A: мощности сложены, как при параллельном соединении

distractors_en.A: the powers were added as for a parallel connection
distractors_en.C: the power of the second lamp only
distractors_en.D: the average of the powers was taken
distractors_en.E: the power of the first lamp only

question_en: $5$ lamps of $75\ \mathrm{W}$ each, rated for the same voltage, are connected in series to a mains of that voltage. With what power ($\mathrm{W}$) does each lamp burn?
question_uz: Har biri $75\ \mathrm{W}$ quvvatli, bir xil kuchlanishga mo'ljallangan $5$ ta lampa shu kuchlanishli tarmoqqa ketma-ket ulandi. Har bir lampa qanday quvvat ($\mathrm{W}$) bilan yonadi?
question_ru: $5$ ламп мощностью по $75\ \mathrm{W}$, рассчитанных на одно напряжение, включили последовательно в сеть с этим напряжением. С какой мощностью ($\mathrm{W}$) горит каждая лампа?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Har bir lampaga U₀/5 tushadi, P ∼ U²: har biri 75/5² = 3 W, jami 15 W.
Asos: P = P₀(U/U₀)².

distractors_en.A: this is the total power of all the lamps
distractors_en.B: the rated power was assumed to remain

question_en: In the circuit in the figure $R_1=2R$, $R_2=R_3=R$. Find the ratio of the heats $Q_1:Q_2:Q_3$ released in the resistors in the same time.
question_uz: Rasmdagi zanjirda $R_1=2R$, $R_2=R_3=R$. Bir xil vaqtda rezistorlarda ajraladigan issiqlik miqdorlarining nisbati $Q_1:Q_2:Q_3$ ni toping.
question_ru: В цепи на рисунке $R_1=2R$, $R_2=R_3=R$. Найдите отношение количеств теплоты $Q_1:Q_2:Q_3$, выделяющихся в резисторах за одно и то же время.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Pastki tarmoq R₂ + R₃ = 2R = R₁, demak toklar teng. Tok bir xilda Q ∼ R: Q₁:Q₂:Q₃ = 2:1:1.
Asos: Q = I²Rt.

uz: Tarmoqlar qarshiligi teng, toklar teng: $$R_2+R_3=2R=R_1,\ \ Q=I^2Rt\ \Rightarrow\ Q_1:Q_2:Q_3=2:1:1$$
ru: Сопротивления ветвей равны, токи равны: $$R_2+R_3=2R=R_1,\ \ Q=I^2Rt\ \Rightarrow\ Q_1:Q_2:Q_3=2:1:1$$
en: Equal branch resistances, equal currents: $$R_2+R_3=2R=R_1,\ \ Q=I^2Rt\ \Rightarrow\ Q_1:Q_2:Q_3=2:1:1$$

distractors.B: hamma rezistorlarda issiqlik teng deb olingan
distractors.C: R₁ dagi tok 2 marta katta deb olingan
distractors.E: Q ∼ 1/R va tok 2 marta katta deb olingan

distractors_ru.B: считали теплоту во всех резисторах равной
distractors_ru.C: считали ток в R₁ вдвое большим
distractors_ru.E: взято Q ∼ 1/R и вдвое больший ток

distractors_en.B: the heat was assumed equal in all resistors
distractors_en.C: the current in R₁ was taken twice as large
distractors_en.E: Q ∼ 1/R and a doubled current were assumed

question_en: The first winding of an electric kettle boils the water in $15\ \mathrm{min}$, the second in $10\ \mathrm{min}$. In how many minutes will the same water boil if both windings are connected to the mains in parallel?
question_uz: Elektr choynakning birinchi chulg'ami suvni $15\ \mathrm{min}$ da, ikkinchisi $10\ \mathrm{min}$ da qaynatadi. Ikkala chulg'am tarmoqqa parallel ulansa, o'sha suv necha minutda qaynaydi?
question_ru: Первая обмотка электрочайника кипятит воду за $15\ \mathrm{min}$, вторая — за $10\ \mathrm{min}$. За сколько минут закипит та же вода, если обе обмотки включить в сеть параллельно?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. U o'zgarmas, qaynash vaqti t ∼ R. Parallel ulashda t = t₁t₂/(t₁+t₂) = 150/25 = 6 min.
Asos: t ∼ R.

en: The times combine like parallel resistances: $$t=\frac{t_1t_2}{t_1+t_2}=\frac{15\cdot10}{15+10}=6\ \mathrm{min}$$

distractors_en.A: the time for a series connection
distractors_en.E: the product of the times, not divided

question_en: A kettle of power $1.5\ \mathrm{kW}$ heated $1.2\ \mathrm{kg}$ of water from $25^\circ\mathrm{C}$ to $100^\circ\mathrm{C}$ in $7$ minutes. Find the efficiency of the kettle (in percent). $c=4200\ \mathrm{J/(kg\cdot K)}$.
question_uz: Quvvati $1.5\ \mathrm{kW}$ bo'lgan choynak $1.2\ \mathrm{kg}$ suvni $25^\circ\mathrm{C}$ dan $100^\circ\mathrm{C}$ gacha $7$ minutda qizdirdi. Choynakning FIK ni toping (foizda). $c=4200\ \mathrm{J/(kg\cdot K)}$.
question_ru: Чайник мощностью $1.5\ \mathrm{kW}$ нагрел $1.2\ \mathrm{kg}$ воды от $25^\circ\mathrm{C}$ до $100^\circ\mathrm{C}$ за $7$ минут. Найдите КПД чайника (в процентах). $c=4200\ \mathrm{J/(kg\cdot K)}$.

en: Useful heat over the energy spent: $$\eta=\frac{cm\Delta T}{Pt}=\frac{4200\cdot1.2\cdot75}{1500\cdot420}=0.6$$

distractors_en.A: this is the fraction of the energy lost
distractors_en.C: the time was taken in minutes: 378/(1.5·7)
distractors_en.D: the final temperature 100 was used instead of ΔT
